# Virtus Group

> > Comprehensive accounting, tax, and business advisory firm serving Saskatchewan and Western Canada with expertise in financial planning, audit, and strategic business solutions.

Virtus Group is a full-service accounting and business advisory firm based in Saskatchewan with offices in Regina and Saskatoon. They provide integrated services spanning tax planning and preparation, audit and accounting, business advisory, wealth management, and business valuation.

## Key Topics

- Accounting Services
- Tax Planning & Preparation
- Business Advisory
- Strategic Planning
- Audit & Assurance
- Private Wealth Management
- Business Valuation
- Leadership Training
- Profitability Improvement
- Change Management
- Estate Planning
- Corporate Tax
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- GST Compliance
- Saskatchewan & Western Canada

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://virtusgroup.ca/services): Comprehensive accounting and business advisory service offerings
- [Accounting Services](https://virtusgroup.ca/audit-accounting/accounting-services): Bookkeeping, GST, year-end, and financial controls
- [Compliance, Audit & Assurance](https://virtusgroup.ca/audit-accounting/compliance-audit-assurance): Audit and assurance services under ASPE, IFRS, and NFPO standards
- [Tax Planning](https://virtusgroup.ca/taxation/tax-planning): Tax planning strategies for personal, corporate, and estate taxation
- [Tax Preparation](https://virtusgroup.ca/taxation/tax-preparation): Tax preparation services including T1, T2, T3, T5 returns and compliance

## Business Advisory & Strategy

- [Business Advisory Services](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-advisory): Strategic planning, leadership training, and exit planning services
- [Strategic Planning](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-advisory/strategic-planning): Strategic planning services for long-term business growth and success
- [Leadership Training](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-advisory/leadership-and-training): Leadership training workshops for team development and governance
- [Profitability Improvement](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-advisory/profitability-improvement): Profitability improvement through waste reduction and optimization
- [Change Management](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-advisory/change-management): Change management strategies and diagnostic tools for organizational transformation
- [Business Health Check-Up](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-advisory/business-health-check-up): Business health assessment diagnostics for performance and growth opportunities

## Wealth & Valuation Services

- [Virtus Private Wealth](https://virtusgroup.ca/services/private-wealth-management): Financial, tax, estate, and retirement planning services
- [Business Valuation & Litigation Support](https://virtusgroup.ca/business-valuation-litigation-support): CBV business valuation, M&A support, and litigation services in Saskatchewan
